title: Enumeration Loop Halting
statement: For any language $P$, input word $x$, and natural number $n$ with $2^n\le B$, let $k,u$ satisfy $u+k=2^n$. For either Boolean value $b$ such that $b$ is true exactly when there exists $w$ with $u\le w<2^n$ and the encoded pair of $x$ and the binary representation of $w$ belongs to $P$, the search program with oracle determined by $P$ halts with answer $b$, while satisfying the program precondition and keeping every register at most $B$ at every earlier step.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is true iff some $w$ in $[u,2^n)$ has the encoded pair of $x$ and its binary representation in $P$
The input is $x$ and the oracle is determined by $P$
